A salary between €4.350,00 and €5.220,00 gross per month (based on 40 hours). A full-time position in a two-shift operation. 27 vacation days and 13 ADV days. A results-based bonus. Functieomschrijving As a CNC Turner, you will be responsible for independently preparing and carrying out various machining operations.
